Transport Documents

インポートディクラレーション

A document filed with customs authorities detailing goods, value, and origin upon import, enabling compliance checks, risk assessment, and duty calculation under national and WCO rules.

Quick answer: A document filed with customs authorities detailing goods, value, and origin upon import, enabling compliance checks, risk assessment, and duty calculation under national and WCO rules.

Why it matters

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is インポートディクラレーション?

In this glossary, インポートディクラレーション refers to: A document filed with customs authorities detailing goods, value, and origin upon import, enabling compliance checks, risk assessment, and duty calculation under national and WCO rules.

How is インポートディクラレーション used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "輸入者は貨物が国境に到着し通関される前に、インポートディクラレーションを電子的に完了した。"

Why does インポートディクラレーション matter in logistics?

インポートディクラレーション matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses インポートディクラレーション?

インポートディクラレーション is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A document filed with customs authorities detailing goods, value, and origin upon import, enabling compliance checks, risk assessment, and duty calculation under national and WCO rules.

Operational example

The importer completed the import declaration electronically before the goods arrived at the national border for customs clearance.
